description: TASK 3 -- Full 10-machine Canvas Factory Digital Twin, scaled from the Task 2 2-machine POC. Shows all 10 real reporting LDI machines (LDI-01..LDI-10) grouped into their 5 real zones (public.devices.location), 2 machines per zone. The 5 dark zone-container rectangles are a pure layout/grouping visual (canvas panel positioning only) -- their placement does NOT represent real physical factory floor-plan geometry, and their neutral color (#1E293B) is deliberately distinct from all 4 semantic machine-state tokens so a zone block can never be mistaken for having a machine-state itself. Each machine node: rectangle body (background color field-bound to that machine's real state via a byName fieldConfig override with value mappings, exactly the Task 2 POC mechanism), text label (real eqp_id), icon (SVG glyph field-bound via config.path -- swaps shape by state; field-bound icon FILL/COLOR was proven non-functional on this Grafana build in the POC and is not attempted here), metric-value (real board_no / total_board), a small MO line (real current mo), and a small alarm badge (active Critical/Major count + Owner + Elapsed, blank when no active unresolved alarm -- same category-to-team Owner mapping and Elapsed formatting as ims-ldi-operator-andon.json's Action Queue panel, additionally scoped to real operator lifecycle status <> RESOLVED). Drill-down: each node links to Machine Snapshot with only var-machine_id and var-factory as real literal values; var-mo/var-event_time_ms are intentionally omitted so the target dashboard's own variable defaults (mo defaults to $__all, event_time_ms defaults to 0 which collapses log_id's ORDER BY to plain time DESC) resolve to the machine's latest event across all MOs -- avoiding the stale-literal problem the POC disclosed. Status board, not an analytics dashboard -- no SPC/RCA/SLA data shown.

panels.title: IMS LDI Factory Digital Twin - 5 Zones x 2 Machines
panels.description: 10-node Canvas factory digital twin. 5 zone containers (layout grouping only, not floor-plan geometry) x 2 machine nodes each. Each node = rectangle body (state color) + text label (eqp_id) + icon (state-glyph via config.path field-binding) + metric-value (board_no/total_board) + MO line + alarm badge (count/Owner/Elapsed, blank when clear). Query targets: refId A..J, one hardcoded literal eqp_id each, LIMIT-1 latest-value shape against public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full joined to the alarm tables, same shape as Andon panel 1000 and the Task 2 POC.

/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: always the true latest row for this one hardcoded machine -- same latest-value shape and same ALARM/OK/IDLE/NO_DATA CASE logic as ims-ldi-operator-andon.json panel id 1000, copied verbatim (state CASE not modified). Node 1 = LDI-01 (fixed literal, not templated -- Canvas has no repeat mechanism, fixed node positions, same reasoning as the Task 2 POC and Andon's own docs on why its repeat mechanism doesn't apply here). icon_path_1 swaps the icon SVG glyph by state (field-bound icon FILL color proven non-functional on this Grafana build in the Task 2 POC fix round 2; path-swap is the working substitute, do not re-attempt fill/color field-binding). badge_1 carries active Critical/Major alarm count + Owner + Elapsed, same query shape (category->team mapping, Elapsed formatting) as ims-ldi-operator-andon.json's Action Queue panel, additionally filtered on real operator lifecycle status <> RESOLVED (public.ldi_alarm_lifecycle) so a badge clears once someone actually resolves the alarm via the alarm-api service. */
WITH s AS (
  SELECT
    v.eqp_id,
    v.mo,
    v.board_no,
    v.total_board,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
        JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
        WHERE a.equipmentid = v.eqp_id AND m.severity IN ('Critical', 'Major')
          AND a.logdate > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
      ) THEN 3
      WHEN NOT v.has_data OR v.is_stale THEN 0
      WHEN v.state THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END AS st
  FROM public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full v
  WHERE v.eqp_id = 'LDI-01'
  LIMIT 1
),
alarm_raw AS (
  SELECT
    CASE m.severity WHEN 'Critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'Major' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS sev_rank,
    a.logdate,
    CASE COALESCE(c.category, 'UNCLASSIFIED')
        WHEN 'VACUUM' THEN 'Maintenance'
        WHEN 'CAMERA' THEN 'Maintenance'
        WHEN 'MOTION' THEN 'Maintenance'
        WHEN 'MOTOR' THEN 'Maintenance'
        WHEN 'ENVIRONMENT' THEN 'Facility'
        WHEN 'NETWORK' THEN 'Automation'
        WHEN 'PLC' THEN 'Automation'
        WHEN 'COMMUNICATION' THEN 'Automation'
        WHEN 'DATABASE' THEN 'IT'
        WHEN 'ALIGNMENT' THEN 'Process Engineering'
        WHEN 'CALIBRATION' THEN 'Process Engineering'
        WHEN 'REGISTRATION' THEN 'Process Engineering'
        WHEN 'PROCESS' THEN 'Process Engineering'
        ELSE 'Maintenance'
      END AS owner,
    CASE
        WHEN NOW() - a.logdate < INTERVAL '1 hour'
          THEN GREATEST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT, 0)::TEXT || 'm'
        ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT || 'h' || LPAD(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT::TEXT, 2, '0') || 'm'
      END AS elapsed
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
  LEFT JOIN public.v_ldi_alarm_category c ON c.alarm_code = a.errorcode::TEXT
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_lifecycle l ON l.logdate = a.logdate AND l.logid = a.logid
  WHERE a.equipmentid = 'LDI-01'
    AND m.severity IN ('Critical', 'Major')
    AND a.logdate > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    AND l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'RESOLVED'
),
alarm_ctx AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::INT AS n,
    (ARRAY_AGG(owner ORDER BY sev_rank, logdate DESC))[1] AS owner,
    (ARRAY_AGG(elapsed ORDER BY sev_rank, logdate DESC))[1] AS elapsed
  FROM alarm_raw
)
SELECT
  s.eqp_id AS eqp_id_1,
  s.st AS state_1,
  CASE s.st
    WHEN 3 THEN 'img/icons/unicons/exclamation-triangle.svg'
    WHEN 0 THEN 'img/icons/unicons/question-circle.svg'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'img/icons/unicons/pause-circle.svg'
    ELSE 'img/icons/unicons/check-circle.svg'
  END AS icon_path_1,
  COALESCE(s.board_no::TEXT, '—') || ' / ' || COALESCE(s.total_board::TEXT, '—') AS board_total_1,
  COALESCE(s.mo, '—') AS mo_1,
  CASE
    WHEN alarm_ctx.n = 0 OR alarm_ctx.n IS NULL THEN '—'
    ELSE alarm_ctx.n::TEXT || (CASE WHEN alarm_ctx.n = 1 THEN ' ALARM · ' ELSE ' ALARMS · ' END) || alarm_ctx.owner || ' · ' || alarm_ctx.elapsed
  END AS badge_1
FROM s CROSS JOIN alarm_ctx
